title: Americans with Disabilities Act, Titles II and III, and DOJ Title II web and mobile accessibility rule (28 CFR part 35, subpart H)
issuer: US Congress; US Department of Justice
version: Title II web rule (89 FR 31320, published 2024-04-24) with compliance dates extended by interim final rule (91 FR 20902, effective 2026-04-20)
applicability: Title II binds state and local governments (WCAG 2.1 AA); compliance now due 2027-04-26 for entities of 50,000 or more population and 2028-04-26 for smaller entities and special districts. Not applicable to Unbound unless a public entity (for example a state university foundation that is a public entity) is a customer, in which case it flows down by contract. Title III (public accommodations) has no codified web standard; courts are split on whether websites of businesses without physical places are covered; DAF sponsors' donor portals face litigation risk, which they will push to vendors contractually. Rating: Title III indirect contractual, medium likelihood; Title II unlikely.
license: US federal government work; not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105). Free to reuse and quote with citation.
limitations: Title III web obligations are case-law driven and unsettled.
notes: Date correction: Title II compliance dates extended from 2026-04-24 and 2027-04-26 to 2027-04-26 and 2028-04-26.

verification.method: Federal Register API 2026-11-25: 2024 final rule metadata and 2026 IFR abstract with extended dates.
